description: This is a Java source file implementing a helper class for testing Akka persistence snapshots related to policies in the Eclipse Ditto project. The class provides methods to retrieve the latest and all snapshots for specific domain IDs, converting them into domain objects, and managing snapshot data.

classes.name: PoliciesSnapshotTestHelper
classes.description: A helper class for testing Akka persistence snapshots for policies, capable of retrieving the latest and all snapshots for a given domain ID, converting snapshot data into domain objects, and handling snapshot pagination.

methods.name: PoliciesSnapshotTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the helper with the ActorSystem, snapshot conversion function, and domain ID mapping function.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshot
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent snapshot for a given PolicyId as an Optional.

methods.name: getAllSnapshotsAscending
methods.description: Retrieves all snapshots in ascending order for a given PolicyId.

methods.name: convertSnapshotDataToDomainObject
methods.description: Converts a SelectedSnapshot into a domain object of type S using the provided snapshotToDomainObject function.

methods.name: getAllSnapshotDataAscending
methods.description: Aggregates all snapshots up to a maximum snapshot in ascending order by traversing the snapshot chain.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshotData
methods.description: Fetches the snapshot data with the highest sequence number up to a specified timestamp for a given persistence ID.

methods.name: getMaxSnapshotData
methods.description: Overloaded method that fetches the latest snapshot data for a given persistence ID.

methods.name: convertScalaOpt
methods.description: Converts a Scala Option to a Java object, providing a default if not defined.

methods.name: waitForFuture
methods.description: Blocks and waits for a Java Future to complete within the specified timeout, rethrowing exceptions as IllegalStateException.
